variants.title: Coast work
variants.premise: He is dragging a wine crate down the pier steps and doesn't stop for you, assembled from reviewer's Coast work, writer-a's Tide's out and Coves not kingdoms, and writer-b's Wine Crates.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Can you get me off this island?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Nilsal. No. Not out.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: That was quick.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: As far as Mistrock. That's still the island.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Coast work only. I like my boat unburnt.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They don't know you. That's the whole of it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask the label.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: The label says wine.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There you go.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Last one said double. He swam back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Suit yourself. It's an island, mind.

variants.title: Off the ledger
variants.premise: He has one foot in the boat, ready to shove off, and stops, assembled from reviewer's Off the ledger and writer-a's Name in a book.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a ship out of Varlamore.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: He looks at the quiver, then at his boat.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Colosseum, that. Thought those were a story.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: So can you take me?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: No. But the registrar will write you down.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Cothon, up in the capital. Ask for him.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I know who keeps the ledger.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's my business to know. Not to visit.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You'll be in a book by evening.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mine's never been in a book. Keeping it that way.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: To that harbour? No.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: They've a very good memory there.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Ask for the registrar. He'll be the bored one.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Timoiva. Don't mention the crates.
